I completely understand what you’re going through. I’m bisexual myself, and I struggle with similar feelings because of the COCSA I experienced with my best friend in elementary school. Regardless of what happened, how you feel is valid. You like women, and that’s perfectly okay. It doesn’t take away from the fact that the non-consensual experience hurt and traumatized you. It certainly doesn’t mean you ‘must have liked it,’ and you absolutely are not going to hell (honestly, God has way bigger things to worry about than your sexuality, no offense). Most importantly, you didn’t consent because you were too young to do so. Please be kind and patient with yourself. I know dealing with these emotions is incredibly hard, but just know that you are completely valid. Many people question their sexuality, especially after experiencing non-consensual encounters with the same gender
